mapper.select: select distinct r.role_key, p.permission_key from t_role r left join t_role_permission_rel rel on rel.role_id = r.id and rel.is_deleted = 0 left join t_permission p on p.id = rel.permission_id and p.status = 0 and p.is_deleted = 0 where r.status = 0 and r.is_deleted = 0 order by r.role_key, p.permission_key
